resources.string: A pet that eats your commits and turns monster when you stop shipping.
Nobody has died yet. Go five days without shipping and that changes.

Your username is enough for public repos you own. Add a token to also count private repos and repos you collaborate on. A fine-grained token with read-only Contents, Metadata and Actions is all it needs. It is stored encrypted on this phone and only ever sent to api.github.com.

When your pet turns monster, the apps you pick are covered by a lock screen until you ship. Calls, messages, payments, maps, settings and your shipping tools are never offered. You can always get out with a mercy unlock, which kills the pet.
Tell me when the pet changes state
Fake a ship or skip time to see every state without waiting days. Skipping time moves the pet clock forward, so real pushes will look older than they are until you reset the clock.
